title: Smooth approximation of a continuous compactly supported function with a common compact support and a uniform bound
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ and let g : ℝ^P = Euclid P → ℝ be continuous with compact support. Then there exist a compact set K ⊆ ℝ^P, a real constant C and functions u_k : ℝ^P → ℝ (k ∈ ℕ) with the following properties: every u_k is C^∞; u_k(x) = 0 for every k and every x ∉ K; |u_k(x)| ≤ C for all k and x; and u_k(x) → g(x) as k → ∞ for every x ∈ ℝ^P.
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (g : Euclid P → ℝ), Continuous g → HasCompactSupport g → ∃ (K : Set (Euclid P)) (C : ℝ) (u : ℕ → Euclid P → ℝ), IsCompact K ∧ (∀ k, ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) (u k)) ∧ (∀ k x, x ∉ K → u k x = 0) ∧ (∀ k x, |u k x| ≤ C) ∧ ∀ x, Tendsto (fun k => u k x) atTop (𝓝 (g x))
